messages.subject: Distance Sampling Warning and Errors
parts:
Hello,

I keep have errors and warning appear when I'm running my analysis and I
was wondering if anybody could help me, or direct me to somebody who can?

I trying to do analysis on line transect, perpendicular data for a
butterfly, and I keep getting several warnings (70) and errors (2). I'm
unable to determine what they mean and was wondering if anybody could tell
me what I'm potentially doing wrong?

My detection function models I'm using are half-normal cosine, uniform
cosine, and hazard-rate simply polynomial.
